lines: You cook on Wednesday and Saturday, and that is what was kept.
The shared dish is vegan: that is what Theodule eats.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.

dishes.name: Zesty Smoky Chickpea Bowl
dishes.title: Smoky BBQ chickpeas with herby quinoa and charred summer vegetables
dishes.method: Assemble the plate using the cooked chickpeas, quinoa, and charred vegetables. Garnish with a sprinkle of fresh parsley.
dishes.why: A vegan-friendly, smoky lunch that uses the stovetop to respect the one-tray oven limit.

dishes.name: Smoky Harissa Chicken Bowl
dishes.title: Roast harissa chicken with herby quinoa and charred summer vegetables
dishes.method: Assemble the roast chicken, quinoa, and charred vegetables. Squeeze over a fresh lemon wedge before serving.
dishes.why: Provides a protein-rich meal for Aurele while keeping the oven free for only one tray of chicken.

dishes.name: Slow-Simmered Smoky Chickpeas
dishes.title: Warm smoky BBQ chickpeas with quinoa and charred corn
dishes.method: Reheat a portion of chickpeas, quinoa, and vegetables in a pan with a splash of water until piping hot. Season with black pepper.
dishes.why: A warm, comforting vegan dinner that hits the smoky flavor profile requested.

dishes.name: Late-Night Smoky Harissa Plate
dishes.title: Warm harissa chicken with quinoa and charred summer vegetables
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken, quinoa, and vegetables in a pan over medium heat. Drizzle with a teaspoon of olive oil to keep it moist.
dishes.why: A warm dinner for Aurele that can be easily reheated in a pan since there is no microwave.

preparations.title: Smoky Harissa Chicken Thighs
preparations.method: Toss the chicken thighs with harissa, smoked paprika, and olive oil. Spread on a single oven tray and roast at 200°C for 35-40 minutes until charred and cooked through.

preparations.title: Slow-Simmered BBQ Chickpeas
preparations.method: Sauté the onion in oil until soft. Add tomato puree, paprika, and drained chickpeas. Stir in the maple syrup and a splash of water, then simmer on low heat for 15 minutes until thick and smoky.

preparations.title: Herby Fluffy Quinoa
preparations.method: Rinse quinoa and boil in stock for 15 minutes. Let sit for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork and stir in the chopped parsley.

preparations.title: Charred Courgettes and Sweetcorn
preparations.method: Heat oil in a large pan. Sauté courgettes and corn on high heat until charred and tender. Stir in garlic for the last 2 minutes.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Preheat the oven and get the chicken roasting on the single tray. While it cooks, start the quinoa on the stovetop. Dice the onion and garlic, then start the slow-simmered chickpeas in a small pot. Finally, char the courgettes and corn in a large pan. Chop the parsley and fluff the quinoa before boxing everything up.
